text:
maria_sales: Quick sync — Borealis wants a perf POC next week. They care about 95ms p50 and <300ms p99 for 512-token responses at ~120 concurrent users. Can we confirm a load plan and cost estimate?
charles_se: thanks — core questions: are they okay with Dedicated for the window? Hosted can do it but costs spike.
julie_acct: from pricing side, they have a $15k monthly budget for POC only. Need rough total for a 3-day run + reserve.
ken_ops: Dedicated is recommended. For target latency we should run on 8xA100s, static shard, enable KV prefix cache. Rough cost estimate: ~ $4.5k/day on dedicated reserved hourly, plus infra overhead.
darren_ds: load plan proposal: 10m warmup, then step to 120 concurrent users over 5m, hold 30m, then 300 concurrent 5m burst test, then cool down. Capture p50/p90/p99 and token/sec. Use Locust or vegeta to simulate clients.
charles_se: experiment config to validate: model = redwood-3b-quant, max_tokens=512, temperature=0.0, stream=false, prompt avg 120 tokens. We'll need to pin model version.
maria_sales: can we run hosted fallback for day 3 to show failover? Borealis asked about graceful degradation.
ken_ops: yes — we can configure smart routing: primary Dedicated, fallback to hosted smaller variant (redwood-3b-quant-fp16) with QoS tagging. We'll log fallback events.
darren_ds: load command (locustfile snippet):
```
class User(TaskSet):
    @task
    def generate(self):
        client.post('/v1/generate', json={
            "model": "redwood-3b-quant",
            "input": "<prompt>",
            "max_tokens": 512
        })
```
Run with: locust -f locustfile.py --users 120 --spawn-rate 10 --headless --run-time 40m
charles_se: measure token throughput with sampling. Capture headroom metrics (GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, batch size distribution).
maria_sales: security note: Borealis wants answers in the security questionnaire about data segregation and KMS. We should confirm Dedicated + KMS key per customer will be used.
ken_ops: confirmed. Dedicated has isolated queues and optional CMEK. I'll attach the SAC ticket for KMS provisioning.
ci-bot: deploy bot: new dedicated pool request created — DP-4672 (owner: ken_ops).
julie_acct: pricing Q: if they scale to 300 concurrent for the burst window, what's incremental token cost?
ken_ops: incremental is mostly GPU runtime. Rough estimate: at 300 concurrent, throughput ~ 2.8k tokens/s across the pool. For 30m burst ~ 5M tokens. At hosted-equivalent unit pricing that's ~$450 (est). Dedicated hourly model: additional $900 for capacity buffer. Total incremental ~ $1.3k for the burst day.
darren_ds: data to capture during run: p50/p90/p99 latencies, 1s/5s CPU load, GPU util, batch size histogram, cache hit rate. Also save raw request traces for 100 sampled requests to replay.
maria_sales: I'll ask Borealis for exact prompt distribution and whether they will stream responses. Streaming changes latency profile.
charles_se: operational checklist for run day:
- model pinned and validated on canary
- warmup dataset (500 unique prompts)
- monitoring dashboard w/ per-route latency and per-token cost
- alert if p99 > 500ms for >2m
- rollback policy: reduce concurrency by 50% then route to hosted fallback
ken_ops: I'll prepare the rollout config and the autoscaler limits. Also will enable prefix caching and set kv_ttl=6h for the run.
julie_acct: commercial ask — if they convert to Dedicated monthly commit after POC, can we apply POC spend as credit? Sales usually can apply up to 50% credit. Need legal ok.
maria_sales: noted — will flag to legal. Borealis also asked whether we can include an SLA for latency on Dedicated.
charles_se: SLA discussions are legal/sales, but we can provide historical 90-day p99 numbers from similar workloads. I'll export the dashboard.
darren_ds: after the run we'll produce a short writeup: test config, raw metrics, anomalies, tuning notes, ops recommendations, and cost breakdown. Target: 1 pager + appendix.
maria_sales: great. Action items: ken_ops -> provision DP-4672 and KMS; darren_ds -> prepare locust scripts and warmup prompts; charles_se -> export historical p99; julie_acct -> draft credit term. I'll send proposed timelines to Borealis later today. :thumbsup:
ken_ops: on it. provisioning ETA 48h.
darren_ds: I'll drop the locust repo link here once ready and include sample results from a quick smoke run later today.
ci-bot: smoke run completed on canary at 1813463600 — p50=78ms p99=210ms for 64-token avg.
maria_sales: perfect — that'll help close.
charles_se: remember to include cost sensitivity if they switch to higher token averages; show a table of cost vs avg prompt length.
maria_sales: will do. Thanks team.
